full_judgment:
Sashanka Shekhar Sarkar, J: This Rule Nisi was issued on an application under Article 102(2)(a) and (ii) of the constitution in the following terms; "Let a Rule Nisi be issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the inclusion of the property under District-Satkhira, Police Station-Shyamnagor, Mouza-Zapa appertaining in SA Khatian 85 and Plot No. 1080, 1259 measuring an area of 6.07 acres of land in the amended "Ka' schedule list of vested property as published in the Bangladesh Gazette Additional issue dated 3rd December 2012 as item No. 172 should not be declared to have been made without any lawful authority and is of no legal effect and further as to why they should not be directed to exclude the said property from the said 'Ka' schedule list of vested property and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper." 

 The respondents are directed to exclude the petitioner's property situated under District-Satkhira, Police Station-Shyamnagor, Mouza-Zapa appertaining to SA Khatian No. 85 and Plot No. 1080 and 1259 measuring of 6.07 acres of land from the amended 'Ka' list of the vested property published in the Bangladesh Gazette Additional Issue dated 3-12-2012 within 90 days from the date of receipt of the judgment.
